use super::*;

pub(crate) fn resolve_error(id: &str) -> String {
    format!(
        "'{id}' is not a system session. Valid ids: a studio KIND ({}) — the two partitioned ones \
         take a technology, as `librarianRust` or `designerReactNative` — a network's architect \
         (`network-<slug>:architect`), or a surface session \
         (`surface-studio:noun-<noun>` / `surface-studio:verb-<noun>-<verb>`).\n\
         `bsc session list` names the studios that actually exist right now: the per-technology ones \
         are DERIVED from what the stores hold, so a technology with no records has no session.\n\
         This verb reaches the app-owned system sessions and the per-network architects — not fleet \
         workers, and not a project's director (a director owns a running fleet, so ending one is the \
         user's act, not the architect's).",
        valid_ids().join(" · ")
    )
}
